note: ONE LIST: every user-facing feature, the role that runs it, the canary that exercises it, where its last real success is recorded, and how stale is too stale. Read by lua/core/feature_health.lua (wa features, /status), by rust/wa-sentinel (wa health) and by the release step in lua/core/land.lua. A feature that ships without a line here fails scripts/check-features-registry.mjs.

features.name: chat
features.last_success: lua/core/chat.lua: the answer of a finished turn is in the ledger

features.name: run-blocks
features.last_success: lua/core/codemode.lua: a run block finished and its result reached the caller

features.name: remote-calls
features.last_success: lua/core/routed_calls.lua: a peer call was answered

features.name: undo
features.last_success: lua/core/undo_command.lua: a change was put back

features.name: self-wake
features.last_success: lua/core/selfloop.lua: a wake was delivered to the session that asked for it

features.name: scheduled-jobs
features.last_success: collector:jobs: the jobs ledger's last finished run

features.name: mail
features.last_success: lua/core/mail.lua: a mailbox read answered with messages

features.name: whatsapp-receive
features.last_success: collector:whatsapp-index: the index holds a message received recently

features.name: whatsapp-send
features.last_success: lua/core/whatsapp.lua: a send was accepted by the transport

features.name: whatsapp-transcription
features.last_success: collector:whatsapp-transcripts: the index holds a transcript that answered

features.name: whatsapp-copilot-reply
features.last_success: collector:whatsapp-posting: the component posted a transcript back

features.name: whatsapp-index
features.last_success: collector:whatsapp-index: a search answered from the index

features.name: release-update
features.last_success: collector:install: the install record names the commit this node runs
